sources.name: Town of Severance: Community Events calendar
sources.defaultVenue: Severance Town Hall, 3 S Timber Ridge Parkway, Severance
sources.notes:
Found and read once on 6 October 2026. CivicPlus site. The calendar page lists eight calendars: Main Calendar (CID 14), Community Events (25), Municipal Court (26), Town Council Meetings (27), Citizen Advisory Board (28), Planning Commission (29), Tree Board (30), Youth Council (31). The Community Events iCal (catID=25) had 6 VEVENT (2 RRULE), dates 2024-11-03 to 2026-12-12, time zone America/Denver: Town Christmas, Trick or Treat Parade, Severance Food Drive, Teen Movie Night, Tree Limb Disposal, Coffee with a Cop. Locations seen: Community Park; Severance Town Hall & Clearview Library; 'Drop off locations TBD'; several items carry only 'Severance CO 80550'. No meetings in this calendar. LOCATION values contain HTML (

tags) that needs stripping. A combined iCal with several catIDs (catID=14,25,...) returned 404, so each calendar is a separate feed. The home page (6 Oct 2026) says Severance Days was cancelled for 2026 and a Neighborhood Concert was held 3 October at Overlook Park. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Clearview Library District: Events (Severance Library)
sources.defaultVenue: Severance Library, 5 Timber Ridge Parkway, Severance
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. Severance is served by the Clearview Library District (not High Plains): branches are Windsor Library (720 3rd Street, Windsor), Severance Library (5 Timber Ridge Parkway, Severance, CO 80550, 970-686-5603, Mon-Thu 10-6, Fri-Sat 10-5, closed Sun), a Bookmobile, and an outpost at Windsor Community Recreation Center (from https://clearviewlibrary.org/about-us/learn-more/hours-locations). The events page is a Communico embed (page config: apiServer https://api.communico.co, showRSS/showICAL true, locations []); events render client-side, and individual events live at clearview.libnet.info/event/<id>. Public feed attempts all redirected to the HTML events page: https://clearview.libnet.info/events/feed/ical, .../events/feed/rss, .../events/upcoming/feed/ical. The home page's upcoming list showed Windsor and Severance programs side by side (Babies and Books, Stay and Play, PAWS for Reading, Teen Dungeons & Dragons, 'Read, Rhyme, and Romp — Severance Library'), so a location filter on 'Severance Library' is needed. No feed read; check the page by hand or revisit for a Communico feed URL. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Town of Severance: Parks & Recreation
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. Parks & Recreation sits under Public Works on the CivicPlus site (3 S Timber Ridge Parkway, 970-686-1218). The page lists the Town's parks: Severance Shores Park, Hunter's Crossing Park, Overlook Park (650 Audubon Boulevard), Hidden Valley Park 1 and 2, Community Park (100 Waterfowl Way), Dog Park, Tailholt Park, Lakeview Park (513 1/2 Broadview Drive), Karen Suman Park (400 S Timber Ridge Parkway), Summit View Park (270 Audubon Boulevard), Blue Spruce Park (50 S Timber Ridge Parkway), plus a Park Reservation Request and 'Parks Master Plan coming soon'. No recreation programs, classes or a recreation centre are listed; the Town has no separate parks calendar, so park events arrive through the Community Events iCal. The regional recreation provider is the Town of Windsor's Community Recreation Center (250 11th Street, Windsor), but https://www.windsorgov.com/Calendar.aspx returned HTTP 403 on 6 October 2026 and is unreachable from here. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Bruce's Bar: Live Music & Other Events
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. Bruce's Bar (123 1st St, Severance; phone (970) 686-2320), the town's long-running bar and Rocky Mountain oyster restaurant. The Live Music page is a plain HTML events list (the events link carries a spot_id parameter typical of SpotHopper-built restaurant sites) with no RSS/iCal: recurring entries 'Live music every Saturday night 7-10 PM', 'Music Bingo every other Monday 6:30 PM', 'Karaoke Wednesdays 7-10 PM', 'Line Dancing last Thursday of the month 7-8 PM', plus one-off items such as New Year's Eve (31 December). Also mentions a 'Nut Run' event page. Band names are not listed on the page. Dead end: G5 Brew Pub (1018 Mahogany Way) hosted the Severance Fall Festival in 2018 but a search result says it closed in October 2022; not fetched. Confirmed 6 October 2026 at the owner’s direction (all core sources whose feed, if any, is the official organizer’s own).

sources.name: Town of Severance: Main Calendar
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. CivicPlus Main Calendar iCal (catID=14): 321 VEVENT, 2 RRULE, dates 2024-07-04 to 2076-11-27 (recurring holiday closures expanded decades ahead), time zone America/Denver. The sampled titles were all closures ('Facilities Closed', 'Christmas Eve - Facilities Closed', 'Thanksgiving - Facilities Closed'); locations are Town Hall (3 S. Timber Ridge Parkway) or 'Severance CO 80550' with embedded HTML. On the October 2026 month view the Main Calendar showed no items, consistent with a closures-only calendar. Low value for events; kept as 'other' in case the Town posts non-closure items here.

sources.name: Weld County: County Calendar and Events listing
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. Weld County (seat: Greeley) runs a Granicus-style site. The County Calendar page and the Events listing page (/Events-directory) both rendered, but neither exposed an RSS or iCal link in the page source (only ?oc_lang= language variants). Items seen from the home page were county-wide (Area Agency on Aging falls-prevention events, Human Services job-seeker workshops, Matter of Balance / Tai Ji Quan classes), none in Severance. Treat as a page to check by hand for county-wide items; low relevance for a Severance weekly.

sources.name: North Forty News: Severance coverage
sources.notes: Found and read once on 6 October 2026. WordPress site; the search feed for 'Severance' returned 10 items dated 15 July to 30 September 2026 (Black Hollow Sun Now Powers Northern Colorado; Former HOA President Charged With Theft; Windsor High School press box; Weld RE-4 students' honors; Weld RE-4 school safety exercise; Human Bean event for food banks), so Severance-specific coverage is occasional and mixed with Windsor and Fort Collins items. A past article, 'Severance Unveils Full Slate of Summer Events', shows the Town's summer slate gets written up here. The Greeley Tribune and Coloradoan cover Severance but block our search agent (reported by the search tool); BizWest and KUNC carry business and water-district stories about Severance (search results only, not fetched).
